title: Pereboom: the missing properties are absolutely intrinsic and physical

statements.text: The most basic properties physics reveals are all dispositional, or extrinsic or only comparatively intrinsic, so there must be presently unknown absolutely intrinsic properties that accompany them. Those properties account for consciousness, and in Pereboom’s version they are close enough to paradigm physical properties to count as physical.

sources.quote: the most basic properties contemporary physics reveals are all dispositional, and thus it leaves us ignorant of the categorical properties needed to explain them
the properties that contemporary physics reveals to us are all extrinsic or only comparatively intrinsic, and thus there must be presently unknown absolutely intrinsic properties that accompany them
close enough in kind to our paradigmatic physical properties to count as physical
